interventions.title: Build a walking rhythm
interventions.summary: Ten-minute walks after two meals this week. Same shoes, same streets — make it easy to repeat.

interventions.title: Steady plates, fewer sugary drinks
interventions.summary: Keep meals regular and swap one sugary drink a day for water or unsweetened tea. Small, not strict.

interventions.title: A calmer wind-down
interventions.summary: Pick a lights-out window and park the phone in another room 30 minutes before. Sleep is a lifestyle lever, not a prescription.

coaching.template: River, your T1→T3 picture is the one to watch — and that is useful information, not a verdict. Weight, movement, and sleep are the levers that show up strongest for you. Start with walks you can keep, not a perfect plan.
